content: Zod v4 key changes: parse() and safeParse() signatures unchanged. z.infer<typeof schema> unchanged. z.object(), z.string(), z.array(), z.number(), z.null() basic creation same. Breaking: z.string().email() deprecated (use z.email()), z.nativeEnum() deprecated (use z.enum() on TS enum directly), ZodError issue names changed (e.g. z.core.$ZodIssueInvalidType). safeParse() still returns {success,data} or {success,error}. error.issues[] still array. .format()/.flatten() deprecated in favor of z.treeifyError(). z.enum(['a','b','c']) string array form still works. z.unknown() still works. Default behavior change: z.object properties with .default() now apply even in .optional() fields.
